Vijay Kumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9
April, 2025
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:51751
Court No. - 75
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 1702 of 2025
Applicant :- Vijay Kumar And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhanshu Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Deepanshu Sharma,G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.

Heard Shri Sudhanshu Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicants, Shri Deepanshu Sharma,
learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 and Sri R. K. Singh, learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant application has been filed to quash the entire proceedings of Case No.2300/IX/2024,
arising out of Case Crime No. 0035/2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P.
Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District- Banda and charge sheet dated 03.11.2023 and summoning order dated 06.07.2024.
3.

It is jointly submitted by learned counsel for the applicants as well as opposite party no.2 that dispute between the parties is matrimonial in nature and now they have settled their dispute amicably and a written compromise has also been entered into between them.
4.

Per contra, learned AGA has raised a preliminary objection that aforesaid compromise is yet to be Vijay Kumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72800369/
1 verified by the court below, therefore, applicants may be directed to file aforesaid compromise before the court below for verification.

entities.text: Vijay Kumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Considering the aforesaid submission, present application is disposed of with a direction to the applicants to file original deed of compromise before the court below, within a period of 15 days.

In case, such compromise is filed before the court below, the court below will verify the same after summoning the parties within a period of two months from the date of receiving the copy of compromise.
After verification of compromise, court below may dispose of the impugned proceeding in accordance with law.

6. It is further provided that for a period of two months or till the verification of compromise,
whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
7.
It is further provided that applicants are at liberty to file fresh application u/s 528 of BNSS, to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified compromise.

Order Date :- 9.4.2025 Sharad/-
